# identify temporal paths from 798 to 131 within window [4302, 42701]
from collections import deque

events_list = events
start_node = 798
target_node = 131
window = (4302, 42701)
start, end = window
# filter events within window
evs = [e for e in events_list if start <= e[2] <= end]
# build mapping: for each source node, list of (time, target) sorted
from collections import defaultdict
outs = defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in evs:
    outs[u].append((t,v))
for u in outs:
    outs[u].sort()

# Also create list of events (u,v,t) sorted by t
# We'll perform BFS starting from all events with u==start_node
start_events = [(u,v,t) for (u,v,t) in evs if u==start_node]
start_events.sort(key=lambda x: x[2])

# BFS state: (current_node, time, path=[(u,v,t),...])
found_paths = []
max_paths = 10

from bisect import bisect_right

# For quick per-node times list
node_times = {u: [t for t,_ in outs[u]] for u in outs}

for se in start_events:
    u0,v0,t0 = se
    # initial path
    q = deque()
    q.append((v0,t0,[se]))
    visited = set()  # visited (node,time) to avoid loops
    while q:
        node,time,path = q.popleft()
        if (node,time) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((node,time))
        if node == target_node:
            found_paths.append(list(path))
            if len(found_paths) >= max_paths:
                break
        # find outgoing events from node with t2>time and t2-time <=600
        if node not in outs:
            continue
        times = node_times[node]
        # index of first event with time > time
        idx = bisect_right(times, time)
        # iterate while t2 - time <=600
        for j in range(idx, len(times)):
            t2 = times[j]
            if t2 - time > 600:
                break
            v2 = outs[node][j][1]
            new_path = path + [(node, v2, t2)]
            q.append((v2, t2, new_path))
    if len(found_paths) >= max_paths:
        break

print('num_start_events:', len(start_events))
print('num_paths_found:', len(found_paths))
# print paths
for i,p in enumerate(found_paths):
    print('path', i+1)
    for trip in p:
        print(trip)
    print()

# Also print earliest times and counts
if start_events:
    times = [t for u,v,t in start_events]
    print('start times min,max:', min(times), max(times))

# Also print direct edge occurrences where u==798 and v==131
directs = [e for e in evs if e[0]==start_node and e[1]==target_node]
print('direct interactions 798->131 count:', len(directs))
for d in directs[:10]:
    print(d)
